data.name: Neon Arcade
data.detailed_description:
What is Neon Arcade?

Neon Arcade is a living, breathing retro-futuristic arcade universe — powered by RiderOS, a fully interactive neon desktop environment that serves as your gateway to dozens of handcrafted games.

Plug in. Power up. Glow on.

Every experience in Neon Arcade shares one unmistakable visual DNA: razor-sharp neon green and electric pink cutting through an infinite dark void, wrapped in glass-morphic menus, particle-lit backdrops, and pulse-driven electronic soundtracks from independent artists. Each game is its own world — but they all belong to the same grid.

One Launcher. Every Genre. Infinite Sessions.

Inside Neon Arcade, you'll find a constantly growing library spanning every arcade genre imaginable — from reflex-hardening action titles and physics-driven experiments to mind-bending puzzles, strategic deep-dives, endless runners, score-chasers, and genre hybrids that don't have names yet. Easy to pick up. Impossible to put down. Every session is designed to hit that "just one more try" nerve.

Whether you've got five minutes or five hours, there's always something glowing on the grid waiting for you.

RiderOS — The Desktop Is the Game

Neon Arcade isn't a list of titles in a boring launcher. It's an operating system.

RiderOS drops you onto a fully functional neon desktop where every game launches as a real, resizable, draggable window. Manage files in the built-in File Manager. Run calculations in the Calculator. Execute commands in the Terminal. View images, read and write documents, change wallpapers, and organize your desktop — all without ever leaving the game. A live taskbar, Start Menu app launcher, desktop icons with drag-and-drop, and translucent glass-panel window chrome blur the line between game and OS.

The desktop is the arcade. The arcade is the desktop.

Always Growing

Neon Arcade launches with a massive Day 1 lineup of 50 games and will continue to expand with free content drops. New games, new modes, and new ways to glow are always on the horizon.

Neon Arcade — Your arcade never looked this good.

data.short_description: There is a place where arcade machines never die and the desktop never sleeps. RiderOS is your portal to 50+ neon-soaked games across every genre, all breathing the same electric air. Log in. Pick a window. Lose the evening.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 / 11
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core (any CPU from 2012+)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with DirectX 11 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: -
  • Additional Notes: Essentially, if your machine can run Chrome and play Snake, it can run this.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.12 Sierra or newer
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core (Intel or Apple Silicon)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio (Core Audio compatible)
  • Additional Notes: Essentially, if your machine can run Chrome and play Snake, it can run this.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+ or equivalent
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0+ capable
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio (ALSA / PulseAudio / PipeWire compatible)
  • VR Support: -
  • Additional Notes: Essentially, if your machine can run Chrome and play Snake, it can run this.
